name: Ample Computer
long_description:
Cloud hosting and infrastructure platform that has everything your agent needs to ship web applications. We set up compute, frontend, database, storage, CDN, email and (soon) text, analytics, and payments. We then monitor, patch and scale your app so you never migrate anything again.

We're doing for the internet software economy what Shopify did for e-commerce - remove the technical barriers to anyone can launch anything.
one_liner: Everything your agent needs to ship a web app
